heading_en: Minimum Required Observation Period for LGD Estimation of Retail Exposures
summary_ja: リテール向けLGD推計の五年以上の観測期間を定める。
summary_en: Requires data covering at least five years for estimating LGD of retail exposures.
paragraphs: In estimating the LGD of retail exposures, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall use one or more of external data, internal data, or data pooled among multiple financial institutions, covering an observation period of five years or more.
